_help: How Sesame sounds. mode: "noises" = pet sounds, and its line is only shown as a caption; "words" = it speaks its line out loud (pet sounds muted). Switch it from the phone or the Lab; tune the rest in Lab -> Voice. Everything is saved here. voice: a gpt-realtime voice (alloy, ash, ballad, cedar, coral, echo, marin, sage, shimmer, verse). style: how the line is acted. pitch: semitones higher (0-12; raises the whole voice like a smaller throat). pace: speed after the pitch shift (0.7-1.4, 1 = normal). wobble: warble depth in semitones (0-1.5).
style: a tiny, curious robot pet: bright, playful, quick, a little breathless, never like an assistant
